name: Ingredion Incorporated
summary: Ingredion Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of sweeteners, starches, nutrition ingredients, and biomaterial solutions derived from wet milling and processing corn, and other starch-based materials to a range of industries worldwide. The company operates in Texture & Healthful Solutions; Food & Industrial IngredientsLATAM; and Food & Industrial IngredientsU.S./CANADA segments.
